name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.enter.SpeechVoiceEnterSloganActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad campaign selects a slogan-style entry animation. It shows the promotion's slogan and reward cue before the ad page.
disableEffect: This ad-entry animation and its associated viewing reward will no longer be available.
